phishing_source.selection: One URL per registered domain outside all legitimate and benchmark domains; deterministic SHA-256 ordering within the matching primary structure bucket.

dataset_composition.split_method: Deterministic SHA-256 rank assignment over legitimate registered domains, with exact target-count quantiles; the resulting cutoffs assign phishing-feed registered domains to the same four partitions. Positive and phishing domains are kept in exactly one partition.

limitations: The phishing feed has no fragment-bearing URLs in the sampled pool; fragment-bearing verified legitimate URLs are retained only in the domain-held-out benchmark.
API-like and search URL examples are sparse in the phishing feed and therefore remain explicitly measured as cohort metrics.
